verdict.rationale: Honeybadger has native natural-language input only for error search: the 'Describe your search' panel turns a plain description into a query. Broader natural-language operation relies on an external AI assistant connected through the official hosted MCP server (with OAuth), which covers project management, error investigation and BadgerQL queries. missing for 10: native natural-language control beyond search (e.g., resolving or assigning errors and configuring alerts in-product), documentation of the scope of write or management actions available via MCP, and independent or hands-on confirmation that natural-language operation works reliably.
